senses.gloss:
m. (-गः)
1 Separation, disjunction.
2 A widower, an absent lover or husband.
3 Unfitness, unsuitableness.
4 Medical treatment, counter to the symptoms.
5 Consistent treatment, non-mixture of opposite qualities.
6 Dislike, aversion to any thing.
7 Vigorous effort, exertion.
8 An iron hammer.
E.
अ neg. and योग union; or अयस् iron, and ग what goes, or is.

m. (-गः)
1 Presenting or offering flowers, perfumes, &c.
2 Action, the performance of an act.
3 A shore or bank.
E.
आङ्, युज to join, घञ् aff.

mf. (-वः-वा-वी)
The offspring of a Śūdra man, and Vaiśya woman.
E.
अयोग disjoined, and व from बा to go; being one of the lowest castes or tribes.

m. (-वः)
A man of a mixed tribe sprung from a Śūdra man and Vaiśya woman; his business is carpentry, &c.
f. (-वी)
A woman of the tribe.

m. (-डः)
1 A chalybeate pill, one made of some preparation of iron.
2 An iron ball.
E.
अयस्, and गुड a ball.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
1 Unfit, unsuitable.
2 Useless.
E.
अ neg. योग्य fit.

f. (-ता)
1 Unfitness, unsuitableness, incongruity, impropriety. अयोग्य and तल् affix; also अयोग्यत्वं.

n. (-ग्रं)
1 A pestle for cleaning grain.
2 A mace of club tipped with iron.
3 A hammer, a forge hammer.
E.
अयस्, and अग्र the end.

m. (-नः)
A hammer, a forge hammer.
E.
अयस्, and घन what strikes, from हन् to kill or strike.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Disunion, separation, distinctness.
E.
अ not, योजन uniting.

n. (-नं)
Effort, exertion.
2 Taking, seizing.
3 Collecting.
E.
आङ् before युज to join, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-दत्-दती-दत्)
Iron-toothed.
E.
अयस्, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
1 Not to be warred against.
f. (-ध्या)
The capital of RĀMA, Ayodhya, the modern Oude.
E.
अ neg. युद्ध to make war, and ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Generated equivocally, not born from the womb.
E.
अ neg. योनि the womb, and ज born.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of iron.
E.
अयस् and मयट् aff.

n. (-लं)
Rust of iron.
E.
अयस, and मल dirt.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Tipped or pointed with iron.
m. (-खः)
A kind of goblin with an iron face.
E.
अयस्, and मुख a mouth.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Stern, unrelenting, iron-hearted.
E.
अयस्, and हृदय the heart.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Collected together.
E.
आङ् before युज to join, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 War, battle, slaughter.
E.
आङ्, युध to make war, affix ल्युट्.
